title: Handbook Acquisition Pipeline
brief: Build HandbookAcquisitionPipelineEngine for bulk handbook ingestion. Handles file upload, extraction orchestration, deduplication against existing registry entries, provenance tracking, and incremental update support for handbook revisions.

units.title: Build acquisition pipeline orchestrator: file intake, extraction dispatch, registry commit workflow with rollback on validation failure
Implement deduplication and merge logic: detect overlapping handbook entries for same machine, merge new sections without overwriting higher-confidence existing data
Implement provenance tracker and revision support: record source document, extraction date, page ranges, firmware version, and support incremental updates when new handbook editions arrive

exit_conditions: Acquisition pipeline ingests a multi-section handbook PDF and commits all valid sections to registry
Deduplication correctly merges new sections without overwriting higher-confidence data
Provenance metadata recorded for every ingested section with source, date, and page reference
